# Reporting a security problem

Please do **not** open a public issue.

1. Best: [report it privately on GitHub](https://github.com/B1progame/LOCALDECK/security/advisories/new).
2. Or write to the address on the [privacy page](https://b1progame.github.io/LOCALDECK/#/privacy).

Say what happens, how to repeat it and what somebody could do with it. A small example helps, please use your own account and your own data. Do not read or change the data of others and do not try to overload the service.

You get an answer within a week. After the fix you are named in the changes if you like. Nobody is paid, and nobody who keeps to this has to fear legal steps from B1progame.

Only the version on <https://b1progame.github.io/LOCALDECK/> and the `main` branch get fixes. What was already checked: [docs/SECURITY.md](../docs/SECURITY.md).
